text: don't be ashamed and don't let your partner or friends convince you its not normal. many foreigners especially when living in parts in israel that english is well spoken dont speak/read/write hebrew at all. BUT - it can really help with integrating. so choose your way of learning/practising it. i did ulpan in the beginning, but was also far from fluent. after a few years when i understood i should really work on it I tried a different approach - watching series in hebrew (with english subtitles), listening more to israeli music, doing duolingo app, tried with a german/hebrew tandem (didnt like it so much), tried to read kids books etc.. try to surround yourself more with hebrew, but dont pressure yourself, find the things that work for you!
